faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (adswizz vergibt je Abruf eine listeningSessionID, AIS leitet ueber hash_redirect um, Last-Modified liegt nur 1 s vor dem Abruf, Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst simplecastaudio.com) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: Stories about people behind masks, secret identities, and hidden personas.
kurzfassung: This episode explores the psychology and reality behind secret identities through three distinct stories. First, a visit to a roadside attraction reveals the actual person operating a giant Paul Bunyan statue. Next, a man's delusional belief that he worked for the CIA leads an innocent acquaintance to attempt bank robberies. Finally, a teenage girl finds profound confidence and freedom by performing as her high school's tiger mascot.
stichpunkte: A roadside Paul Bunyan attraction features a mechanical giant operated by a person hidden inside the torso.
A 21-year-old man named Hurston Torres carried out five failed bank robberies after being convinced by a man named Josh Brady that he was working on a covert government operation.
Josh Brady orchestrated the fake bank robberies while suffering from delusional disorder, believing he was communicating with the CIA.
Clinical psychologist Dr. Evan Nelson explains that delusional disorder involves plausible beliefs that do not violate the boundaries of reality, unlike schizophrenia.
A woman known as Emily shares her experience living with a husband who suffered from the jealousy subtype of delusional disorder.
A teenage girl named Navy transforms from an awkward student into an exceptionally confident performer when wearing her high school tiger mascot costume.
In Juarez, Mexico, a vigilante known as Diana the Hunter shot multiple bus drivers following widespread impunity surrounding violence against women.
Local residents in Juarez expressed understanding and support for the vigilante's actions due to systemic failure and police corruption in investigating sexual violence.

clips.text: A man attempted five bank robberies over the course of four days without managing to steal any money.
A man orchestrating elaborate covert operations was actually living at home with his mother and grandmother.
A young girl developed an intense fixation on animal costumes and sports mascots that worried her father.
A teenager who struggled with basic physical coordination in daily life could effortlessly perform advanced acrobatics while wearing a mascot suit.
The annual number of murdered women in a border city surged drastically from dozens to hundreds over a short period.

beschreibung:
A bank robber on an undercover mission. A teenage girl with the powers of a tiger. A vigilante seeking vengeance in Ciudad Juárez. All have secret identities — but not all of them chose those identities for themselves.

(00:00:00) Prologue: Ira attempts to solve perhaps the most unsolvable mystery at the Trees of Mystery in California: Who is the voice of Paul Bunyan? (7 minutes)
(00:07:23) Act One: If you ever think about assuming a secret identity, you may want to take a little time to consider the possible consequences. Jon Ronson tells the tale of a bank robber who absolutely does not take that advice. (22 minutes)
(00:31:33) Act Two: Elna Baker shares a story about her teenage cousin, Navey Baker, who maintains a secret identity while being a public figure: she's the school mascot, a tiger, at her high school. (11 minutes)
(00:41:28) Act Three: While we were putting together this week's show, we heard about a real-life Avenger with a secret identity in Ciudad Juarez, Mexico. Writer Yuri Herrera lived on the border for several years and spent a lot of time in Juarez. He went back there to see what effect this secret Avenger has had on the city. (13 minutes)
